# opnsense_telegraf_key (Resource)

Global tags added to every Telegraf metric (**Services ▸ Telegraf ▸ Tags**, plugin `os-telegraf`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_telegraf_key" "site" {
  name  = "site"
  value = "rom"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) This will enable or disable the key mapping. Defaults to `true`.
- `name` (String) Set the name of this mapping. Defaults to ``.
- `value` (String) Set the value of the defined key. Defaults to ``.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the Telegraf global tag.
